settings.title.note: Page and document title for every Settings section.

settings.loading.note: Screen-reader label while loading values from the bridge.

settings.sections.label.note: Accessible name for the five Settings section links.

settings.section.schedule.note: Section link and heading for unattended run timing.

settings.section.run.note: Section link and heading for task and browser options.

settings.section.notifications.note: Section link and heading for Windows notifications and the optional webhook.

settings.section.app.note: Section link and heading for window and startup preferences.

settings.section.advanced.note: Section link and collapsed disclosure heading for custom paths, logs and diagnostics.

settings.saved.note: Inline success message after save_settings succeeds.

settings.unsaved.note: Status beside Save when at least one value differs from the last loaded values.

settings.external_change.text: Settings changed outside the app. Your edits are kept. Reload to use the latest values.
settings.external_change.note: Warning when settings.changed arrives with local unsaved edits. Does not discard them.

settings.reload.note: Explicit action to discard local edits and load the latest saved values.

settings.field.invalid.note: Fallback beside a field for an unrecognized validation code, while the bridge's own error message remains visible.

settings.schedule.description.text: Windows keeps the schedule running even when the app is closed.
settings.schedule.description.note: Schedule section description. Windows Task Scheduler is independent from the window app.

settings.schedule.mode.label.note: Accessible label for the three schedule mode choices.

settings.schedule.mode.automatic.note: Schedule mode that checks open work during a time window.

settings.schedule.mode.fixed.note: Schedule mode that runs at a single clock time.

settings.schedule.mode.manual.note: Schedule mode without any scheduled runs.

settings.schedule.automatic_help.text: Check during this window and run when enough work is open.
settings.schedule.automatic_help.note: Consequence of automatic scheduling. Does not expose a points-threshold control.

settings.schedule.check_count.note: Read-only number of checks for the automatic schedule. count is numeric; checks are not editable in the UI.

settings.schedule.fixed_help.text: Run once on each selected day, even if the page cannot be read first.

settings.schedule.manual_help.text: Nothing runs on a schedule. You can still choose Run now on Overview.
settings.schedule.manual_help.note: Consequence of manual scheduling. Run now and Overview name existing UI actions.

settings.schedule.window.label.note: Label above the paired start and end time inputs.

settings.schedule.time.label.note: Label for the fixed-mode local time input.

settings.schedule.days.label.note: Label for the weekday picker. Weekday names follow the user's regional format.

settings.schedule.delay.label.note: Schedule delay selector label; delayed starts spread the checks without changing configured clock times.

settings.schedule.delay.none.note: Random-delay selector option for zero minutes.

settings.schedule.delay.minutes.note: Random-delay selector option. count is the numeric allowed delay in minutes.

settings.schedule.catch_up.label.note: Switch controlling StartWhenAvailable in Task Scheduler.

settings.schedule.catch_up.help.text: Try after you sign in if the PC missed a scheduled time.
settings.schedule.catch_up.help.note: Supporting consequence of catch-up, without promising an immediate run.

settings.schedule.battery.label.note: Switch that permits scheduled work while the laptop is on battery.

settings.schedule.battery.help.text: Runs can use power while your laptop is unplugged.
settings.schedule.battery.help.note: Supporting battery tradeoff under the schedule switch.

settings.schedule.next_check.note: Schedule status line in automatic mode. time is a regionally formatted local date and time; random delay means around.

settings.schedule.next_run.note: Schedule status line in fixed mode. time is a regionally formatted local date and time.

settings.schedule.not_ready.text: The Windows schedule is not ready yet. Save these settings to update it.
settings.schedule.not_ready.note: Status when a scheduled mode has no matching registered app task.

settings.schedule.legacy.text: An older daily task also runs at {time}. It would run alongside this schedule.
settings.schedule.legacy.note: Legacy-task notice. time is a formatted time or the localized unavailable label. The old task is not removed without a user action.

settings.schedule.legacy_unknown.text: An older daily task would run alongside this schedule.
settings.schedule.legacy_unknown.note: Replaces the timed legacy notice when its time is unknown. The registered older task is known, but no missing-time label or invented time is shown. Replace and Keep both actions are unchanged.

settings.schedule.replace.note: Action to replace the detected legacy task with the app schedule.

settings.schedule.keep.note: Dismisses only the notice for this visit; neither task changes.

settings.schedule.replace_title.note: Confirmation dialog heading before removing the one detected legacy task.

settings.schedule.replace_body.text: The older task will be removed. This app's schedule takes over. Your accounts and browser data stay as they are.
settings.schedule.replace_body.note: Confirmation consequence for replace_legacy_task. No other scheduled task is touched.

settings.schedule.replaced.text: The app's schedule replaced the older task
settings.schedule.replaced.note: Success after replace_legacy_task returns. Uses the same wording as setup.schedule.replaced for the same completed replacement.

settings.run.browser.label.note: Label for the three browser presentation modes.

settings.run.browser.visible.note: Browser mode with an ordinary visible Edge window.

settings.run.browser.hidden.note: Headless browser mode without a visible Edge window.

settings.run.browser.visible_help.text: You can watch and help if a page needs attention.
settings.run.browser.visible_help.note: Help for the selected visible browser mode; explains that the user can interact with Edge.

settings.run.browser.hidden_help.text: No browser window. If sign-in is needed, switch back to Visible.
settings.run.browser.hidden_help.note: Help for the selected hidden browser mode, including how to recover when a page needs sign-in.

settings.run.tasks.label.note: Group label above the seven task switches.

settings.run.source.label.note: Selector for how desktop search terms are obtained.

settings.run.source.trends.note: Search-term source option using trends, with no AI setup.

settings.run.source.ollama.note: Search-term source option using the user's local Ollama service.

settings.run.source.openrouter.note: Search-term source option using the user's OpenRouter key.

settings.run.ollama_url.label.note: Label for the local AI service URL, usually localhost. Do not put a real address into the catalog.

settings.run.ollama_model.label.note: Selector label for model names returned by list_ollama_models.

settings.run.models.refresh.note: Button to request model names from the entered local Ollama address.

settings.run.models.empty.text: No models were found at this address.
settings.run.models.empty.note: Inline message when the local Ollama list is empty.

settings.run.openrouter_key.label.note: Label for the masked API key editor. A saved key is never rendered back into it.

settings.run.openrouter_model.label.note: Label for the OpenRouter model id text editor; the id itself is user data.

settings.run.openrouter_help.text: Uses your OpenRouter account. Any provider charges are yours.
settings.run.openrouter_help.note: Plain consequence of selecting OpenRouter. The app does not offer a provider plan or price.

settings.secret.saved.text: Saved. Type a new value to replace it.
settings.secret.saved.note: Password-field placeholder based only on secrets_set; the page never receives the saved secret.

settings.secret.empty.note: Password-field placeholder when no secret is configured.

settings.secret.remove.note: Action that sends an empty string for this key or webhook on the next Save; an untouched field is never sent.

settings.notifications.policy.label.note: Selector for run-finished Windows balloon notification policy.

settings.notifications.policy.always.note: Notification policy option for all run results.

settings.notifications.policy.errors.note: Notification policy option for partial or failed results.

settings.notifications.policy.never.note: Notification policy option that suppresses Windows balloons.

settings.notifications.webhook.label.note: Optional secret HTTPS URL editor for the user's Discord webhook.

settings.notifications.webhook.help.text: Optional. Sends the same run summary to your Discord channel.
settings.notifications.webhook.help.note: Description of the optional webhook without showing the URL.

settings.app.autostart.label.note: Switch for starting the window app hidden in the tray at user sign-in.

settings.app.autostart.help.text: Keep the app in the tray after you sign in. The schedule works without it.
settings.app.autostart.help.note: Supporting startup consequence; disabling startup does not stop scheduled runs.

settings.app.tray.label.note: Switch for hiding the window instead of quitting when its close button is used.

settings.app.tray.help.text: Closing the window keeps the app ready. Choose Quit in the tray to exit.
settings.app.tray.help.note: Supporting close-to-tray consequence and the explicit way to quit.

settings.app.language.label.note: Language selector label. Shipped language names come from app_info, never pseudo locales.

settings.app.language.system.note: Language selector option for system language detection.

settings.app.language.help.text: The app reloads after a language change. Numbers and dates still follow Windows.
settings.app.language.help.note: Supporting language consequence; the shell owns the reload after a successful save.

settings.app.updates.label.note: Switch allowing a daily update check, without automatic installation.

settings.app.updates.help.text: Checks once a day. You choose when to download an update.
settings.app.updates.help.note: Supporting update consequence; no automatic installation or download.

settings.app.updates.check.note: Explicit manual update check with force=true.

settings.app.updates.current.note: Result of a successful manual update check with available=false.

settings.app.updates.available.note: Result of a successful manual update check. version is the release version returned by the bridge.

settings.advanced.edge.label.note: Custom msedge.exe path editor; leaving it empty uses automatic discovery.

settings.advanced.edge.help.text: Leave empty to find Microsoft Edge automatically.
settings.advanced.edge.help.note: Supporting consequence of clearing the custom Edge path.

settings.advanced.driver.help.text: Leave empty to download a driver that matches Edge.
settings.advanced.driver.help.note: Supporting consequence of clearing the custom driver path.

settings.advanced.folder.help.text: Leave empty for the default folder. Changing this does not move existing browser data.
settings.advanced.folder.help.note: Supporting data-folder consequence. Prevents implying that selecting a folder migrates profiles.

settings.advanced.pick.note: Shared path-picker action beside each Advanced path editor.

settings.advanced.log.label.note: Selector for the farmer log level.

settings.advanced.log.info.note: INFO log level option, the default.

settings.advanced.export.label.note: Explicit button opening the native save dialog for a redacted diagnostic archive.

settings.advanced.export.help.text: Includes settings, recent run records and logs. Keys and webhook addresses are removed; browser data is left out.
settings.advanced.export.help.note: Diagnostics contents and privacy boundary. Does not claim that arbitrary user text in logs is anonymous.

settings.advanced.export.saved.note: Success message after a non-cancelled export. path is the native save-dialog output path returned by the bridge.
